name: Israel, Gaza & region
summary: Saudi-led coalition says it struck 50 Houthi targets across Yemen on 26 Nov after a projectile hit the Jazan refinery
state: The Saudi-led coalition said on 26 Nov it destroyed 50 military targets in Sanaa, Hodeidah and Saada, including a launch platform it linked to the attack on Saudi Arabia's Jazan refinery that killed a Nepali worker (Express Tribune, Anadolu). WHO figures cited by Anadolu put deaths in Yemen at 2,361 between August and 23 Nov. With Gulf states also under attack on 26 Nov (The National), cross-border strikes on several fronts keep the Alert.
for_you: Follow FCDO travel advice for Israel, Lebanon, Yemen, Saudi Arabia and neighbouring states. Disruption to regional flights and shipping can occur at short notice.
rubric_hit: Multi-front escalation with major cross-border strikes = Alert

why: Conflict involving Israel, Gaza, Lebanon, Syria and Yemen threatens civilians, shipping and wider escalation. Direct hostilities with Iran are tracked under Gulf / US–Iran war.

rubric.alert: Multi-front escalation, major cross-border strikes between Israel and its neighbours, or mass-casualty events.
rubric.watch: Ongoing hostilities on one front, or a ceasefire repeatedly violated.
rubric.normal: Ceasefires holding across fronts (Gaza, Lebanon, Syria, Yemen).
